title: Correct the combat/action-resolution section: 'combat' and 'status' are system-layer composition, not core VTT vocabulary -- the core must not know these concepts exist
objective: Owner corrected the previous 'Combat/action resolution flow' design: giving the core Command types named DeclareAction/ResolveRoll and a DomainEvent named ActionResolved baked the concept of 'combat'/'action' into what should be an agnostic core -- the VTT engine itself must not need to know 'combat' or 'status' exist at all. Those are one layer above: system-layer composition using the core's neutral primitives (entity/key-path storage, generic modifier application with Change Modes, dice-formula rolling via ndm/DeterministicRng, generic turn/initiative ordering, vision/LOS computation), not core-level concepts. This mirrors this repository's own DEC-052/ADR-0014 'Composable capability packages' principle already applied elsewhere in the monorepo: packages expose neutral mechanisms and replaceable defaults, while applications (here, a 'system') compose concrete policy on top -- the previous section violated that by naming core-sounding Command/Event types after a combat-specific concept. Correcting docs/research/vtt-rules-and-character-system-options.md's 'Combat/action resolution flow' section to explicitly reframe DeclareAction/ResolveRoll/ActionResolved as an illustrative example of ONE possible system-layer composition of the generic primitives, not new core-level vocabulary the VTT itself defines, and restating the core's actual minimal generic surface (entity/key-path store, generic ApplyModifier command, generic Roll primitive, generic turn ordering, vision computation) with no notion of combat, damage, status, or actions baked in anywhere.
validations: Rewrote the 'Combat/action resolution flow' section's framing: renamed/reframed to make explicit that DeclareAction/ResolveRoll/ActionResolved are an illustrative example of system-layer composition, not core VTT vocabulary -- the VTT core itself never needs a concept of 'combat,' 'action,' or 'status' to exist.

Added an explicit statement of the core's actual minimal generic surface (entity/key-path store, a generic ApplyModifier command with no notion of what it represents, a generic Roll primitive, generic turn ordering with no notion of what a turn is for, vision/LOS computation) -- cross-referencing this repository's own DEC-052/ADR-0014 'Composable capability packages' principle (neutral mechanisms + replaceable defaults in the core, concrete policy composed by the layer above) as the same discipline already established elsewhere in this monorepo, not a new one invented for this document.

No dependency installed, no code written, no ADR reopened -- documentation correction only, consistent with AGENTS.md's rule against hardcoding a consuming product's policy inside a reusable capability.
risks: Documentation correction only -- no code, no dependency, no ADR change.
This is a design proposal, not validated by any spike or prototype.
